prompts.prompt: In Azure Cosmos DB, what is the maximum storage size permitted for a single logical partition? Answer with the exact size.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/cosmosdb/SKILL.md - Partitioning section: Logical partition maximum size is 20 GB. Corroborated in references/architecture.md Logical Partitions section.

prompts.prompt: In Azure Cosmos DB's NoSQL API, approximately how many Request Units does replacing an existing 1 KB item cost, given that a replace operation reads the old item before writing the new one? Answer with the approximate number of RUs.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/cosmosdb/references/architecture.md - RU Cost Benchmarks table: Point write / replace (1 KB item) costs approximately 10.7 RU (reads old + writes new).

prompts.prompt: For Azure Cosmos DB reserved capacity, approximately what percentage discount does committing to a 1-year reservation provide on provisioned throughput cost? Answer with the approximate percentage.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/cosmosdb/references/best-practices.md - Cost Management, Reserved Capacity section: 1-year reservation gives approximately 20% discount.
